description: This file defines the BrowserSessionPanelManager class responsible for managing a VSCode webview panel related to browser sessions, including creation, updates, navigation, and disposal.

classes.name: BrowserSessionPanelManager
classes.description: Manages a VSCode webview panel for browser session visualization, handling creation, updates, navigation, and disposal.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns an existing instance or creates a new one for a given ClineProvider.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Creates or reveals the webview panel and initializes it with current session data.

methods.name: createOrShowPanel
methods.description: Creates a new webview panel if none exists, or reveals the existing one.

methods.name: updateBrowserSession
methods.description: Updates the webview with new browser session messages and active state.

methods.name: navigateToStep
methods.description: Navigates the webview to a specific step index, queuing if not ready.

methods.name: resetManualCloseFlag
methods.description: Resets the flag indicating manual closure by the user.

methods.name: shouldAllowAutoOpen
methods.description: Determines if the panel should auto-open based on manual close status.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the panel is currently open.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the panel and cleans up resources.

methods.name: getHMRHtmlContent
methods.description: Generates HTML content for development mode with hot module reloading.

methods.name: getHtmlContent
methods.description: Generates static HTML content for production mode.
